evidence: app/package.json:12-16 — @sveltejs/kit 3.1.0 / svelte 5.57.3 / vite 8.3.5: the entire app rests on the current stable line, but SvelteKit 3.0 was released 2026-10-01, i.e. ~4 weeks before today
app/vite.config.js:7 — sveltekit({ adapter: adapter() }) plugin config, the Kit-3-only configuration style (svelte.config.js no longer supported)

app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45-52 — goto(url, { shallow: true, replace, reset: false, state }) — the shallow-routing goto options added in 3.0.0-next.13 and first stable in 3.0.0 (Oct 2026), used centrally for home-page filter/pagination URL sync
app/package.json:18-21 — '#lib' subpath import alias, the alias Kit 3 introduced to replace $lib
app/src/routes/moves/[name]/+page.server.js:14 — error(404, 'Not found'), the new Kit 3 error(status, message) signature (object form deprecated)
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js — server data layer is plain fetch + Map memoisation; no experimental framework surface at all
reach.rationale: No experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs — but two central features (home-page URL sync via new goto options, and the Kit-3 config/import pattern) rest on APIs stable only since the 3.0 release four weeks ago, which lands squarely on the 'recently-stable in central places' anchor.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45-52 and app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:14 — the only two goto call sites in the app; everything else uses long-stable runes, snippets and load functions
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:28 — untrack (stable since Svelte 5.0) isolated to one state initialisation line
app/vite.config.js:1-10 — the only configuration file; contains no experimental flags or compiler options to unwind
grep across app/src for unstable|experimental|preview|beta — zero hits; the measured experimental marker list is empty
containment.rationale: There is essentially nothing experimental to contain, and what is new (Kit 3 goto options, plugin config) is confined to two components and one config file, so a future API shift would touch a handful of lines.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45-52 — shallow: true is well chosen: per-keystroke URL sync skips re-running the dex load and a server round trip, something a plain goto cannot do
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:78-80 — afterNavigate filters popstate to resync filter state from the URL, i.e. the new navigation is used deliberately, not decoratively
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:28 — untrack used exactly as documented (initialising $state from props without creating a reactive dependency)
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:14 — goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true }) buys nothing: those options were removed in Kit 3 in favour of reset: false
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:3 — process.env.API_BASE_URL read directly instead of Kit 3's explicit env vars (src/env.js + $app/env/private), skipping the framework feature gratuitously
justification.rationale: The genuinely new APIs are each justified by behaviour a long-stable API can't provide (shallow routing avoids needless load re-runs). The one unjustified use is the removed noScroll/keepFocus pair, which should simply be reset: false, plus a bypass of the framework's env mechanism.

findings.issue: goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true }) passes options that SvelteKit 3 removed (replaced by a single reset option); Kit ships the dedicated error kit/goto_options_removed for this call, so at best the options are ignored and the page scroll/focus resets on every Game selection, at worst goto rejects
findings.suggestion: Replace with goto(url, { replace: true, reset: false }) — the Kit 3 equivalent that actually preserves scroll and focus

findings.issue: Reads process.env.API_BASE_URL directly, bypassing SvelteKit 3's explicit environment variables (src/env.js with defineEnvVars + $app/env/private), so there is no declaration, validation or dev-time .env support for the app's one config input
findings.suggestion: Declare API_BASE_URL in src/env.js via defineEnvVars and import it from $app/env/private, keeping a fallback for local runs

findings.issue: The home page's filter/pagination sync depends on goto's shallow routing options, stable only since SvelteKit 3.0 (Oct 2026); a breaking change to these options would break URL-sync behaviour on the app's main page
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is (it is the intended use), but consider isolating the option object in one helper so the shape can be updated in a single place if the API moves

summary: The app is conservative: zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs, with all Svelte 5 rune/snippet usage long-stable and idiomatic. Its only exposure is that it is written entirely against SvelteKit 3.1 — the current stable line, released four weeks before today — including new-in-3.0 goto options used deliberately and correctly on the home page. The single misalignment with the current release is a medium-severity use of goto options (noScroll/keepFocus) that Kit 3 removed in favour of reset: false.

experimentalApis.api: goto(url, { shallow, reset, replace, state }) — shallow routing options
